summary_en: 104,000 shares (3.48% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-06 at ¥2,222/share (closing price 2026-08-05) for aggregate limit of ¥231.1M. Results to be published post-execution same day. Forms part of 122,000-share program (¥330M limit) authorized 2026-05-14 for acquisition through 2027-02-28.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares via Off-Hours Market Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-05, Regal Corporation announced execution of a block buyback order under an authorization granted by board resolution on 2026-05-14. The company will submit a buy order for up to 104,000 ordinary shares (3.48% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury) via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading at the Tokyo Stock Exchange on 2026-08-06 at 8:45 a.m., using the closing price of 2,222 yen per share from 2026-08-05 as the execution price. The aggregate acquisition limit is ¥231.088 million. Results will be published upon completion of trading. This block acquisition is part of a larger program authorized 2026-05-14 with an upper limit of 122,000 shares (¥330 million) and an execution window running through 2027-02-28, to be conducted via both regular market purchase and ToSTNeT-3 transactions. As of the announcement date, zero shares had been acquired under the program.
